theme.rationale: Laundry management application (Jadiwangi) uses an energetic, fresh, tactile and trustworthy palette (Warm Sand / Lavender Tint / Pure Surface / Jadiwangi Royal Blue and Violet Accents) built for Indonesian laundry operational staff and store owners.

employee_order_flow.step_1_trigger: Employee taps 'Terima Order' (or FAB button on employee dashboard)
employee_order_flow.step_2_customer_selection: Modal or bottom sheet opens showing existing customer search. Includes prominent '+ Pelanggan Baru' button.
employee_order_flow.step_3_new_customer_form: If new customer: inline or modal form to input Nama Lengkap, Nomor HP (WhatsApp ready with +62 formatting), Alamat (opsional). Provides 'Simpan & Download vCard / Hubungkan Kontak HP' action that automatically creates the customer and triggers phone contact saving (.vcf file download / link) so the contact is stored on the phone and linked to WhatsApp.
employee_order_flow.step_4_service_selection: Services are categorized and COLLAPSED by default (Accordion format per category: Kiloan, Add-on, Bed Cover, Selimut, Bantal & Guling, Boneka, Atasan, Bawahan, Ibadah, Sepatu & Tas, Karpet & Gorden, Kasur, Lantai). Clicking a category header smoothly expands its service cards.
employee_order_flow.step_5_service_cards_and_minimum_order: Each service card is clickable to select and increase quantity. When an item has a minimum order (e.g. min 4 kg or min 5 kg), the card clearly displays 'Min. X kg' badge. Selecting the item or typing quantity automatically initializes or adjusts quantity to satisfy minimum order requirement with informative visual badge feedback.
employee_order_flow.step_6_addons_and_owner_setting: Add-on category (e.g., Add-on Dettol, Parfum Premium, Anti Noda) is selectable as cards and fully configurable by Owner in Setting/Kelola Produk (owner can customize price, active state, min order, duration, icons).
employee_order_flow.step_7_whatsapp_receipt: Once order is created or confirmed, direct action button 'Kirim Nota WhatsApp' links directly to WhatsApp with pre-composed professional digital laundry receipt.

instructions_to_main_agent: - Ensure the entry button on employee page index.tsx says 'Terima Order' clearly (data-testid='btn-terima-order' & 'fab-buat-order').
- In order-baru.tsx: Customer Picker MUST have a '+ Pelanggan Baru' toggle/button.
- When '+ Pelanggan Baru' is active, show input fields for Nama Pelanggan, Nomor WhatsApp / HP, and Alamat.
- On saving new customer: call api.post('/customers', { name, phone, address, outlet_id }), automatically select this new customer.
- Enable automatic saving to phone contact via vCard generation (data URI or blob .vcf with name and TEL) or direct tel/wa link so it integrates seamlessly with device phonebook & WhatsApp.

- CATEGORY ACCORDION: DO NOT show all services expanded at once. Group services by category and keep them collapsed by default (or expand first active category). Clicking any category header toggles expansion with smooth animated/accordion feel.

- MINIMUM ORDER ADJUSTMENT: Services with min_kg (e.g. min 4kg, 5kg) must have their first increment automatically snap to the minimum requirement (e.g., tapping add on Cuci Kering Setrika with min_kg=4 sets qty=4 immediately instead of 1, and decrements cannot go between 1 and 3 without resetting to 0 or warning). Provide clear badge 'Minimal X kg'.
- ADD-ON CARDS: Add-on services (Add-on Dettol, etc.) must be selectable cards with instant feedback.

- OWNER SETTING MANAGEMENT: Confirm and enhance owner manage produk (/app/frontend/app/manage/produk.tsx) to allow setting minimum order (min_kg), pricing, add-ons, and categories so owner has complete control.

- WHATSAPP NOTA INTEGRATION: Ensure that after creating the order, there is a prominent 'Kirim Nota via WhatsApp' button (using buildReceiptWhatsAppUrl or Linking.openURL to wa.me/<phone>) so employee can send invoice proof immediately with one click.

- MUST keep all data-testids intact and add testids: 'btn-new-customer', 'input-new-cust-name', 'input-new-cust-phone', 'btn-save-new-customer', 'cat-accordion-[category]', 'service-card-[id]', 'btn-send-whatsapp-receipt'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: Avoid generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Ensure high touch usability for phone screens (React Native / Expo Web mobile layout).
Containers with borders must have internal padding (p-4 to p-6) to avoid text collision.
Never use generic raw transparent backgrounds on modals or sticky bottom bars. Use surface colors with high contrast.
Every button and interactive element MUST have testID attribute.
